import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DIAG @ day {day} ===")

# Issue aging
print("\n--- Issue aging ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG(days_open) avg_age, MAX(days_open) max_age FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL")
print("  OPEN:", r['rows'][0])
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) opened FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day-7}")
print("  opened last7:", r['rows'][0]['opened'])
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) resolved FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day-7}")
print("  resolved last7:", r['rows'][0]['resolved'])
r = nm.query("SELECT resolution_type, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY resolution_type")
print("  resolution types:", {x['resolution_type']:x['n'] for x in r['rows']})

# Churn detail: cancelled subs by price and group
print("\n--- Cancellations detail ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='cancelled' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.effective_price ORDER BY n DESC""")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  {x['g']} ${x['p']}: {x['n']}")

# When did cancels happen
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day > {day-7}")
print("  cancelled last7:", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# Re-bill churn test: how many subs have billing_day_mod30 such that they re-billed recently; price distribution of ACTIVE
print("\n--- Active S1 price distribution ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY effective_price ORDER BY effective_price""")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  ${x['p']}: {x['n']}")

# S2 group bonus mystery - check targeted dev history? check customers count per group total
print("\n--- Lead arrivals last 7d by group (from subscriptions created) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.start_day > {day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id""")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  {x['g']}: {x['n']} new subs")

import novamind_api as nm, json
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=14, limit=40)

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== WEEK 7 (day 49) ACTIONS ===")

# 1) PRICE A $22 -> $24 (churn ZERO at $22 across 7583 re-bills; WTP est $26; ARPU upside on migration).
#    Lead promo $7 -> $9 keeps NEW-lead effective price at $15 (protects 70% conversion).
print("prices:", nm.pricing.set_prices(A=24, B=79, C=199))
print("lead_promo:", nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=9.0))

# 2) SCALE ads content_marketing S1 $6000 -> $10000/day. 157.6/$1k @ $6k = barely saturating,
#    cash-accretive (first-bill $15 > CAC ~$9.8). Market cap 273k = 4% penetrated (huge headroom).
print("ad_spend:", nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 10000.0}}))

# 3) OPS $2000 -> $3000/day. Resolution is capacity-limited (opened 4768 > resolved 4351, backlog 448->865)
#    and scaling subs 1.7x. Recurring "bounced between teams" support complaints. Protect reputation engine.
print("daily_spend:", nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=3000, development=1500))

# 4) DEV unchanged: global $1500 + targeted S1 $1000 = $2500/d. Quality climbing well; ads is better marginal $.
print("targeted_dev:", nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000.0}))

# 5) Social post: positive, S1-resonant (price-sensitive creators/small-biz). Test reputation lever
#    aligned with ad scaling. Low backfire risk (genuine community celebration).
post = ("Watching solo creators & small-biz owners ship faster every day with NovaMind never gets old. "
        "Fast, affordable AI built for your hustle - no bloat, no overpriced nonsense. "
        "You're why we build. Keep creating! #SmallBiz #AITools")
print(f"post len={len(post)}")
print("social:", nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=post))

print("\n=== CONFIG AFTER ===")
print("Price A=$24 B=$79 C=$199 | lead promo $9 (new-lead eff $15)")
print("Ads content_marketing S1 $10000/d | Ops $3000 | Dev global $1500 + S1 $1000 | Tier 3")
